name: Bukhara
tagline: Living Silk Road city of minarets and trading domes
summary: Bukhara is a 2,000-year-old oasis city where caravanserais, trading domes and madrasas still fill the old town. Climb toward the Kalyan Minaret, explore the Ark fortress, see the Samanid Mausoleum and relax with tea under the mulberry trees at Lyabi-Hauz.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are ideal; summers are scorching.
arrival: Bukhara airport has flights; the Afrosiyob train from Samarkand takes about 90 minutes.
gettingAround: The old town is compact and walkable.
cashTip: Cash is still king; ATMs and cards work in cities. Carry small som notes for bazaars and taxis.
foodTip: Plov, samsa and tea at Lyabi-Hauz.
buyTip: Carpets, suzani, knives and ceramics in the trading domes.
